neet_phy_u09_t04_1.working: A rigid non-linear molecule has 3 translational and 3 rotational degrees of freedom, giving f = 6.

neet_phy_u09_t04_2.working: Each active vibrational mode adds 2 energy terms (kinetic and potential), so 2 modes add 4. Total = 3 + 3 + 4 = 10.

neet_phy_u09_t04_4.working: Total = 3 translational + 2 rotational + 2 vibrational = 7. One vibrational mode gives one KE and one PE term, so R is true and explains A.

neet_phy_u09_t04_5.working: Rigid linear CO2 has 3 + 2 = 5 degrees of freedom, not 6, so I is false. O2 vibration is essentially frozen at 300 K, so f = 5, and II is false.
